description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the Footprint model in the Goteo project. It includes unit tests for creating, validating, saving, associating with SDGs, categories, spheres, social commitments, and deleting Footprint instances. It also tests icon management and retrieval of footprints based on related entities.

classes.name: FootprintTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the Footprint model, testing creation, validation, relationships, icon management, and deletion.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests if a new Footprint object is an instance of the correct class.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests the validation and saving logic of the Footprint object.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation, validation, and retrieval of a Footprint object.

methods.name: testIcon
methods.description: Tests icon handling for a Footprint object, including setting and retrieving icons.

methods.name: testSdgRelationships
methods.description: Tests adding SDGs to a Footprint and retrieving them.

methods.name: testGetFootprintFromSdgs
methods.description: Tests retrieval of Footprints associated with a given SDG.

methods.name: testGetFootprintFromCategories
methods.description: Tests retrieval of Footprints from a given category.

methods.name: testGetFootprintFromSpheres
methods.description: Tests retrieval of Footprints from a given sphere.

methods.name: testGetFootprintFromSocialCommitments
methods.description: Tests retrieval of Footprints from a social commitment.

methods.name: testRemoveSdgRelationships
methods.description: Tests removal of SDG relationships from a Footprint.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a deleted or non-existent Footprint.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Clean-up method to delete test data from the database.
